{{Quote|No one leaves my crosshairs alive.|Zinda Kent|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Zinda Kent''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal who was a henchman of a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], Kent was fair-skinned and had blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]], and her lieutenants were known as "Blade Sisters."<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zinda Kent appears as one of the possible Henchmen Bounties in the Bounty Contract Week, a recurring World Event added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3. Kent can be summoned by using Rendezvous Beacon H-69, which appears on the planets [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The player has the option to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her or capture her alive with [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], so as a result, this article refrains from assuming which crime lord she worked for, where she was encountered, and her fate.<ref name="TOR" />
